title: Gray Subway Tile Kitchen Backsplash
summary: Kitchen backsplash installation using gray subway tile, with careful protection of countertops, cabinets and electrical openings during construction.
problem: The kitchen needed a durable, finished backsplash surface between the countertops and upper cabinets.
solution: Protected the work area, laid out and installed gray subway tile around cabinets and electrical openings, then prepared the installation for grout and final detailing.
materials: Outlet extensions and finish plates as required

images.caption: Protected countertops and cabinets during backsplash installation.
